settings.headline: Made By Hand. As It Always Was.
settings.subline: Five steps. Zero shortcuts. The same process, unchanged, for generations.

settings.title: Wild Harvest
settings.body: Agaves grow for up to 12 years in the mineral-rich earth of Oaxaca before hand-selection. No cultivation. The soil decides.

settings.title: Pit Roast
settings.body: Hearts roast for days over river stone in earthen pits. The smoke doesn't just flavour — it becomes the mezcal.

settings.title: Tahona Crush
settings.body: A two-tonne volcanic stone wheel, horse-drawn, slowly releases every fibre of the agave. Ancient technology. Irreplaceable results.

settings.title: La Fermentación
settings.subtitle: Fermentation
settings.body: The crushed agave fibres and juice rest in open pine or clay vats. Wild airborne yeasts do the rest — unhurried, uncontrolled, alive. Time is the only ingredient.

settings.title: El Alambique
settings.subtitle: Copper Still
settings.body: Double-distilled in small copper pot stills. Adjusted only by the maestro's palate. No shortcuts. No compromise. Never.
